what: The release build's kernels under compute-sanitizer on an RTX 5090: on the sm120 tier, and on the sm80 and sm75 tiers forced with INKRS_PTX_TIER (this GPU is not their hardware). memcheck, racecheck and synccheck are filtered to the tier's own PTX entries; initcheck runs unfiltered and counts errors in those entries only. Racecheck runs p0 on one of its tiles and Hecate; on the other workloads it outgrew its host-memory cap or ran past 40 minutes (not_run). Then which of each tier's PTX entries the workloads launched (nsys), reader-v2's peak device memory at batch 64 (the rise in memory.used, PHerc. 1447 native crop, d -2..2, both directions, stride 64), and Hecate bf16 batch 32 on the whole PHerc. 1447 segment twice in a row from an empty cache: run 1 compiles the PTX and times cuDNN's algorithms, run 2 replays both

workloads.p0: the per-layer check of hybrid_3d2d-seed42 on S1 tiles
workloads.hec-fp32: Hecate fp32, edge strip, both sides
workloads.hec-bf16: Hecate bf16, edge strip, both sides
workloads.tta: TRACE v3B with --tta 8, PHerc. 1447 native crop
